$comment: The citation ledger. Each entry's KEYWORDS must literally appear inside the cited range -- that catches the dangerous half of citation drift (a range that resolves but describes the wrong code). Keywords are code/measurement tokens only; none is original-site copy. extraction/verify_all.py re-checks every entry on each run, which is also how motion values are RE-GREPPED against current source.
degradesGracefully: Citations point at the SIBLING source project (paths relative to the folder containing design-repo/), which is build-time evidence and is NOT shipped. 'audit:<file>' entries point at the external pixel-audit dumps under auditRoot (relative to the same folder). When either is absent -- a standalone copy or an extracted zip -- verify_all.py WARNS and skips rather than failing. registry.manifest.json's entryPoints list only files inside design-repo/.

sectionHeights.build: npm ci + npx vite build --outDir <scratch>/dist, served by npx vite preview --port 5713
sectionHeights.method: First route of each template, scrolled top to bottom and back to trigger viewport-enter content, then every direct element child of <main> measured (getBoundingClientRect height). shell.nav is position:fixed (inFlow false, takes no page height); the footer CTA block (conversion.demo-cta / conversion.demo-form) is measured inside <footer>; shell.footer is the rest of <footer>. One element holding two nodes is recorded once with both ids (sections[]); one element split into several sections (R6) records each part (parts are measured inside the element). Empty spacer divs (<= 80px, no children) are recorded under spacers and count toward the page only.
